item.title: Four business models emerging from Australia’s nature-positive startup scene
item.description: KPMG’s Nature Positive Challenge finalists reveal four distinct business model patterns emerging in Australian climate tech, from AI-enabled ocean restoration to circular textile recycling infrastructure.

item.title: Healthcare and tech workers are ditching degrees for quick-fire courses
item.description: New research from Risepoint shows 26% of online learners gained salary increases after short courses, as two-thirds study in high-need sectors like healthcare and education.

item.title: ANCAP’s 2025 rankings reveal electric vehicles lead in safety performance
item.description: Electric Vehicle Council’s Aman Gaur says ANCAP’s 2025 rankings prove Australians don’t have to choose between sustainability and safety, with six EVs claiming top spots.

item.title: Newoldstamp: Email Signature Management Platform
item.description: Newoldstamp: Streamline email signature management for consistent branding and professionalism across teams.

item.title: ASIC flags 11 flashpoints that could shake businesses in 2026
item.description: ASIC Chair Joe Longo has outlined 11 key risks facing Australian businesses in 2026, including retail exposure to private credit markets, AI-powered cybercrime and superannuation operational failures.

item.title: Why Victoria ranks dead last for doing business and what it means for your bottom line
item.description: Earlypay CEO James Beeson warns Victorian SMEs face mounting pressures from rising costs, patchy demand and growing compliance burdens, with the state ranking last nationally for business competitiveness.

item.title: February rate hike now 73% likely after hot inflation data stuns markets
item.description: Markets jumped from 56% to 73% odds of a February rate hike within hours of today’s CPI release. Matt Bell of Oliver Hume says the sugar hits expected months ago haven’t materialised for property.

item.title: Asset finance surges 41% as SME working capital enquiries turn negative
item.description: Asset finance volumes jumped 41% in Q3 2025 whilst working capital enquiries turned negative by year’s end, according to Valiant Finance’s Alex Molloy.

item.title: Documenso: Open-Source Secure eSignature Solution
item.description: Documenso: An open-source platform for secure, customizable electronic signatures, providing businesses with control over digital agreements.

item.title: VibeTrans: AI-Powered Real-Time Translation Platform
item.description: VibeTrans: AI-driven platform for quick, accurate, and context-aware translations across 1,200+ languages, breaking barriers efficiently.
